subject: Fictional evolution timeline on an illustrated arm and hand

units.definition: Synthetic time units before the fictional endpoint; not real geological ages

axis.direction: older at left, younger at right

point_event_groups.label: CELL ONSET
point_event_groups.icon: small green cell with a darker nucleus

point_event_groups.label: FOSSIL HORIZON
point_event_groups.icon: small dark fossil or rock medallion
point_event_groups.placement: above the palm, just right of the raised thumb

point_event_groups.label: IMPACT PULSE
point_event_groups.icon: small dark impact body with an orange-red flame

point_event_groups.label: COLD PULSES
point_event_groups.icon: four equal white circles, one per event
point_event_groups.placement: below the palm, left of the era boundary

point_event_groups.label: EXTINCTION A
point_event_groups.icon: cyan accent with a dark cross at the event anchor
point_event_groups.placement: below the palm, right of the era boundary

point_event_groups.label: EXTINCTION B
point_event_groups.icon: pale yellow accent with a dark cross at the event anchor

point_event_groups.label: RECENT ARRIVAL
point_event_groups.icon: tiny orange point on the timeline near the fingertip
point_event_groups.placement: on the band, with its label below the fingertip

interval_event_groups.label: TRACK INTERVAL
interval_event_groups.placement: above the fingers, below the impact annotation
